However, FR-002 and Constitution Principle VI require the 'entanglement score' (covariance/eigenvalue) to be computed PER SAMPLE to serve as a predictor variable in the Random Forest (FR-004). A global constant has zero variance across samples, making it impossible for the model to learn a correlation (SC-001). The task order implies a valid feature set, but the artifact produced by T022a is semantically invalid for the consumer (T027a/T031). T022a must be removed or refactored to compute per-sample eigenvalues before T025.
